hits.title: ClockFence observation window
hits.snippet:
UTC_LEASE_WINDOW_63: ClockFence observation pending.
For a confirmed UTC sample interval of 400 ms, compare the preceding sample and the current sample before marking the observation complete.

hits.title: LeaseMux incident appendix
hits.snippet:
Record A: An observation was opened.
Record B: A record was attached.
Record C: The observer recorded a sample.

hits.title: LeaseMux audit note
hits.snippet:
AUDIT_NOTE_71: LeaseMux evidence boundary reached.
The observation confirms only that the appendix was requested. It does not establish that its contents were available.

hits.title: RetryEnvelope reconnect REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY dashboard
hits.snippet:
# Dashboard display vocabulary

The dashboard places the terms RetryEnvelope, reconnect and REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY in the same chart legend.

hits.title: Stale owner epoch and duplicate send
hits.snippet:
The operator must establish that the former producer has relinquished that marker before treating the replacement producer as safe.
An elapsed delay by itself does not establish relinquishment.
The rule complements the E4 state observation; it does not determine that state or approve changing project bindings.
